# File `post-rewrite`

Reconcile submodules after rebase or amend rewrites commits.

Git supplies the rewrite command and old/new object pairs, but the hook does not need to replay that history. Only the gitlinks in the final checked-out tree matter, so all rewrite forms can follow the same synchronization path.
